pages.text: $(bold)Cursed Energy Discharge$(): hurl your cursed energy out as pure force.$(br2)$(bold)Forward (Technique Key)$(): fire a bolt of cursed energy along your sight that deals heavy damage to the first enemy it hits; armor can reduce it and material traits trigger normally. It costs a moderate amount of cursed energy and has a short cooldown.$(br2)$(bold)Reversal (Reversal Key F)$(): Granite Blast — cursed energy discharged continuously as a laser cannon:$(li)every 2 ticks, it damages enemies hit along your sight$(li)ignores invulnerability frames$(li)lasts 3 seconds; you can keep turning your view to steer the beam$(li)when it ends, both the Forward and the Reversal enter a 6-second cooldown together$(br2)$(bold)This technique is unaffected by technique burnout$() — it can still be discharged while burnout is active.
